text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: sustained 5xx surge on hosted-api-eu-prod. Group: api-prod-errors. 12% 5xx over 3m. Pager link: https://incidents.redwood.example/2799990000
Maya: Ack. I'm primary but I'm boarding a flight in ~25m for the holiday. I can triage initial blast window but need a night cover if this goes >30m. Who can take over at 23:00 UTC?
Priya: I can take it. I'm local EU and on holiday but waiting on standby. Happy to be primary at 23:00 UTC if it's still flaring.
Jon: I'm listed as secondary but I'm at a family thing tonight. I can be on-call via phone for urgent pager escalations but can't be primary for a long stretch.
Ash: Quick check: metrics show spike correlating with a traffic surge from a single tenant (Flowdesk) sending large batch requests hitting long context lengths. p95 latency +1.8s.
Kei: Logs show repeated eviction errors followed by retries from the gateway:
```
2026-03-05T22:36:12Z model-pool-1 stderr: EvictionError: KV cache eviction thrash
2026-03-05T22:36:13Z gateway access: 429 retry loop for tenant=flowdesk
```
Maya: Runbook fragment: if KV eviction thrash, enable cache sticky mode and reduce background priming, then spin up a small extra node pool for model-workers. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/kv-eviction-thrash
Ash: I'm going to: 1) enable sticky cache, 2) add 2 nodes to eu-inference-pool, 3) apply temporary rate-limit to large tenants. Will run canaries.
Maya: Do it. Priya if you need to escalate to throttle policy I can handover the creds now.
Priya: I have creds. Command set I'm about to run:
```
redwoodctl cache set --pool model-pool-1 --mode sticky
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=8
redwoodctl tenant-rate-limit set --tenant flowdesk --max-rps 10 --reason "protect cluster"
```
Priya: Executed sticky cache. Canary worker started and stable. Scaling to 8 replicas in progress.
deploy-bot: scale action triggered by Priya: deployment/model-worker -> 8 replicas. https://deploys.redwood.example/rollouts/9001
Ash: After scaling, 5xx down to ~3.5% and p95 back to +450ms. Looks promising.
Kei: I'm worried about background cache priming causing a spike in backend DB. Suggest temporarily disabling asynchronous priming until traffic normalizes:
```
redwoodctl cache priming disable --pool model-pool-1
```
Priya: Disabled priming. Noted.
Maya: Customer impact check: Flowdesk saw ~40% of generation calls 5xx, AcmeCorp unaffected. Olivia, we should prep a short notify for Flowdesk only — say transient increased errors due to large batch traffic, mitigation applied, ETA for full stability ~30m.
Olivia: Drafted and sent to #customer-notify for review. Will wait for stable <1% to send final note.
Maya: Handoff plan: I will stay online for the initial 30m while in transit. Priya will take primary at 23:00 UTC if errors <4% and scaling holds. Jon remains secondary reachable by phone. Kept monitoring notes in incident page.
Priya: Confirmed. My handoff checklist I'll post at takeover: 
- error_rate_5m < 4%
- deployment/model-worker replicas >=8 and all Ready
- cache mode = sticky
- priming disabled
- customer notify drafted/sent if stable
Priya: Posting quick status: errors now 2.2% (5m), p95 +480ms, replicas rolling up: 6/8 Ready.
Maya: Great. If anything regresses above 5% re-escalate to full page and consider immediate fallback to fp16 model variants for heavy tenants. Runbook: revert_quant_profile link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/revert-quant
Ash: Note: fallback to fp16 for Flowdesk can be done via routing policy: 
```
redwoodctl route set --tenant flowdesk --model v2-fp16 --reason "reduce memory pressure"
```
Priya: I'll keep that as plan B.
deploy-bot: Incident update logged. Watch window extended by 30m.
Jon: If you do the fp16 fallback ping me. I'll hop on if the phone rings.
Maya: Current status prior to boarding: errors 1.1% (5m), p95 +300ms, flowdesk rate-limited, priming off. Handing to Priya at 23:00 UTC unless things change. Thanks team. :heart:
Priya: I'm primary now (23:00 UTC). Running through checklist: error_rate_5m=0.9%, rollout=successful, cache=sticky, priming=disabled, customer_notify=sent(draft approved). Will monitor next 40m and update.
Priya: If error_rate creeps >2.5% I'll: 1) re-enable priming for small window, 2) consider fp16 fallback for Flowdesk, 3) call Jon.
Maya: Thanks Priya. Safe flight.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress, primary=Priya, secondary=Jon, watch until 23:40 UTC. Auto-update planned every 10m.
